title: BNPB historical victim-impact overlap eligibility gate
research_question: Can source-native 2000-2017 district/city victim-impact metrics be reconciled value-for-value against official BNPB 2010-2024 retrospective releases at the same geography grain?

current_release_contract.package_title: Kompilasi Data Kejadian dan Dampak Bencana

separate_2024_district_affected_resource.title: Jumlah Korban Terdampak Akibat Bencana Menurut Kabupaten 2024

result.blocking_reason: The reviewed official 2010-2024 victim-impact resources are national disaster-type-by-year matrices, while the historical archive is district/city-by-year. A value-level reconciliation requires the same geography grain; aggregation or synthetic allocation is not authorized.

next_gate.title: BNPB district/city victim-impact counterpart discovery
tasks: Search official BNPB/DIBI holdings for district/city victim-impact observations covering at least part of 2010-2017.
Prefer immutable source-native district/city records or event-level records that can be aggregated without person deduplication claims.
If a same-grain counterpart is found, reconcile each metric separately and retain release-level revision flags.
Do not infer district values from national hazard totals and do not use the 2024-only district affected resource as evidence for 2010-2017 equality.
